cards.title: Melee heroes, your notes
cards.text: Old Guard, Dame, Griffon, Bulwark, Warhelm, Bearskin, Haymaker: every 0.19 note. Live in 0.28.0.
cards.why: Mark any part that's off. Slashes now follow the weapon's real path, and a struck unit gets a pale wash instead of going solid white.

parts.title: Old Guard
parts.text: Parry: the greatsword laid flat across his front, blows caught and sent back. Rally: three gold waves and gold light on the floor; hasted friends trail pale blue copies (every Haste now looks like this). Last Stand: whoever is last standing gets it while he's in the party; stronger on him.

parts.title: Dame
parts.text: Her sword sweeps in across her front. Challenge III hastes her as she goes in; the taunted foe wears the red V.

parts.title: Griffon
parts.text: Hammer raised, then down well forward into a round crater, no cracks (the mystery shape was the old falling hammer head). Stormhammer: the thrown hammer is his own; whirl is a circle; no yellow arrows. Swoop and Wing Guard: wings shaped like his helm wing, about 40% smaller, over him.

parts.title: Bulwark
parts.text: The stab drives straight out along the spear, off to his side; Brace's glint is on the spear head.

parts.title: Warhelm
parts.text: Same wind-up and crater as the Griffon; his free hand rests at his side. Skull Splitter: he leaps over them, drawn above, and lands in a wide crater with forked lightning.

parts.title: Bearskin
parts.text: Bear Claws: a pounce, then 3 slower paw swings stepping in (tier III: 5, then a bite flat with him). Hibernate: lies flat, warm glow, big Zs; wakes with a roar. Maul: club overhead, straight down into a crater, no star.

parts.title: Haymaker
parts.text: Fork centred and pointed ahead. Hay Bale: he rides behind it, no hairs, a straw trail, hay bursting on hits. Toss: the fork goes in low, carries the foe up over his head, then throws it behind him.

parts.title: Not quite yet
parts.text: The Maul's squash is there but hard to see. Swoop no longer snaps round on landing, but he still turns to face the foes he knocked away.

cards.title: One outline
cards.text: Every figure, prop and boss now has the same outline thickness, drawn by the game, not by the art.
cards.why: You asked for consistent outlines not built into sprites. The art never had them baked in; the game drew one that grew with the sprite (bees 1.3, heroes 2.5, the Seraph 6). Props had theirs baked in the file. Now one line for all.

cards.title: Big bosses look lighter
cards.text: With one outline the big bosses (Seraph, Ent, Engine) carry a hero's line and read lighter. Keep?
cards.why: It's the rule you asked for; their silhouettes still read on the floor. The other way is one exception: bosses a little thicker.
